prerequisite.details: The committed scenario declares no prerequisites and no acquisition was performed.

checks: Physical identity was WIN11-02 at 192.168.56.62 on Ethernet in the elevated administration context.
Defender was healthy; Sysmon64 and SplunkForwarder were running and automatic; puppet was stopped and disabled.
Sysmon and PowerShell Operational channels were enabled, effective PowerShell policy was Restricted, and no Alert2IR-WS07-*.bin residue existed.
The exact resolved target did not exist before execution.
The pre-execution local record-ID watermarks were Sysmon 1301315 and PowerShell Operational 3258.
CBS RebootPending and Windows Update RebootRequired were false.

Pre-existing PendingFileRenameOperations contained 24 architect-reviewed Windows print-driver rename entries. Architect accepted them as unrelated to this WS07 scenario set. The value was not modified and no reboot was performed.

post_state_verification.details: The exact UUID-scoped target was absent after the exact reviewed cleanup command.

deviations: Pre-existing PendingFileRenameOperations contained 24 architect-reviewed Windows print-driver rename entries. Architect accepted them as unrelated to this WS07 scenario set. The value was not modified and no reboot was performed.
